data.narrative:
Unspun is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $57M to date. The valuation analysis incorporates a peer set of five robotics and manufacturing companies spanning Seed through Series B stages, including Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Humanoid ($1.4B, Series A), and Walden Robotics ($1.1B, Seed). The broader comparable universe includes eight private peers and one public company.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the $57M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, yielding $114M. Peer-median analysis across the five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $1.6B (range: $1.1B–$2.0B), reflecting the higher absolute valuations observed in the robotics sector at these stages.

Triangulation across both methods produces a range of $97M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $882M. The wide spread reflects a fundamental tension between the stage-progression approach, which anchors to capital raised, and peer-median analysis, which incorporates sector-specific scaling dynamics. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Unspun's technology differentiation and market timing justify positioning within the peer distribution, and whether early-stage capital efficiency will sustain through future fundraising milestones.
